evidence.title: Data Table Filters | Svelte Datatables Examples

name: Data Table Filters
summary: Library-agnostic filter component for Svelte data tables, installed as a shadcn-svelte registry block.
description: Docs for a Svelte data table filter component with text, number, option and date operators that works client-side or server-side. It covers column configuration, the filter controller and the DataTableFilter UI, and is installed with the shadcn-svelte CLI and managed as your own source.
contains: filter component with text, number, option and date operators
installed as a shadcn-svelte registry block and kept as source
concepts: column config helper, filter controller, FiltersState, DataTableFilter
6 quick examples and a locale prop for internationalization
